## Fungus Man (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
N Small plant  
**Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +9  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 16 each (3d8+3)  
**Fort** +4; **Ref** +3; **Will** +2  
**DR** 5/slashing or piercing; **Immune** poison, plant traits, **Resist** cold 5  
**Weaknesses** vulnerable to fire  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** slam +5 (1d3+2)  
**Special Attacks** spore cloud  


**Statistics**


**Str** 6, **Dex** 15, **Con** 13, **Int** 9, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 11  
**Feats** [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon FinesseB  
*House rules: Agile Maneuvers is part of Weapon Finesse; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Perception +9, Stealth +10  


**Special Abilities**


**Spore Cloud (Ex)** Once per round as a standard action, a fungus man can release a cloud of noxious spores. All living creatures within 5 ft. must make a DC 12 Fortitude save or become nauseated 1 for 1d4+1 rounds. The save DC is Constitution-based. This is a poison effect, and once a creature successfully saves it is immune to the spore cloud of that particular fungus man for 24 hours.  



**About**


**Environment** underground  
**Organization** pod (4–16), branch (17–30), colony (30+, plus a fungus man king)  
**Treasure** incidental
